# Clinahir

> Technology and patient-journey support for radiology and medical imaging center owners in Morocco.

- Website: https://clinahir.tech/
- Business demo requests: https://clinahir.tech/#book-demo
- Languages: French and English.

The public clinic dashboard contains fictional records for demonstration. It is not connected to a live clinic, patient database, PACS or DICOM archive. The private /admin workspace manages Clinahir business leads and website content, not patient records.

Demo requests are business inquiries. Do not submit medical information or prescriptions. CRM and WhatsApp delivery depend on private server configuration. No legal compliance certification, partner network, clinical availability or pricing is asserted by this file.
